name: Create-change loop failed → stamp agent.run.outcome=failed on the run entity
description:
ADR-053 Phase 4a′ pattern, applied to create-change. Fires when any create-change role terminates with an involuntary failure (outcome in [failed, truncated]) BEFORE emitting its decide() terminal. Stamps agent.run.outcome=failed on the RUN entity so agent-run/04 transitions executing→failed — otherwise the failed loop wedges the chain and the run stays `executing` forever (the zombie this pattern kills).

Run-phase COMPANION to rule 06 (which stamps chain.paused.marker on the loop for the operator surface). 06 surfaces 'this loop paused, look'; this rule advances the run lifecycle. Same event, different subjects (06: subjectless on the loop; 07: the run entity via the anchor override) — no conflict.

ANCHOR (agent.run.entity_id): every create-change role carries agent.run.entity_id — create-change is an unbroken loop-spawn chain from the run_scope=new dispatch (rule 01), so the framework re-stamps agent.run.entity_id at every spawn (graph_writer.go:535-539). No create-change loop is spawned by a run-entity-fired rule, so none falls back to a lineage-only anchor — no anchor split needed (unlike dev-via-test). Mirrors research/09.

metadata.companion_to: 06-loop-failed-pause.json (operator chain.paused.marker, untouched). This rule adds the run-phase transition.
metadata.anchor: agent.run.entity_id — framework-inherited on every create-change role via the loop-spawn chain (no run-entity-fired spawn). Mirrors research/09's anchor + research/07's success-stamp anchor.
